mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% in the prior month, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a severe weakening in consumer demand, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of elevated inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 (index, 2017=100) in the prior month, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that erodes corporate revenue growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery phase (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 120000), a surge in housing starts (HOUST > 1000 thousand units) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and the trigger condition (UNRATE<5.0% and PAYEMS>120000) is met, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
